scenes.intro.lines.0.text.en: Oh! Your Majesty — you came! Welcome home to Oakville. Well… to what the fog has left of it.

scenes.intro.lines.1.text.en: I’m Isolde. I kept the royal library — but most of the court fled the fog, so… I’m your Royal Advisor now!

scenes.intro.lines.2.text.en: Advisor. Ha! Last time she advised anyone, it was the old king. To read more.

scenes.intro.lines.3.text.en: This is Hob, our woodcutter. He’s the only one who never left. He says the fog doesn’t scare him.

scenes.intro.lines.4.text.en: Scare me? It’s greedy, that’s all. Loves a shine. Toss it a coin and it gives a bit of ground back.

scenes.intro.lines.5.text.en: Then let’s feed it! Those trees in the fog are ours — tap it, Your Majesty. Five coins, Hob says.

scenes.intro.lines.6.text.en: Timber! It worked! And look — right beside it. Something glinting in the fog. Clear that one too!

scenes.intro.lines.7.text.en: That’s Widow Pell’s purse. Dropped it running, she did. Well — the fog owes us. Tap it.

scenes.intro.lines.8.text.en: The fog kept more of what they left, I’m sure of it. Three more stands, and the axes will have work again.

scenes.intro.lines.10.text.en: The folk sheltering in the Townhall saw it all — they’ve gathered you a gift! Go on, accept it.

scenes.morningBook.lines.0.text.en: Trees aplenty, and nobody left who knows how to drop one safe. My hands shake too much now.

scenes.morningBook.lines.1.text.en: Oh — let’s set this aside first, and step back out to the kingdom.

scenes.morningBook.lines.2.text.en: Then a book will teach them! I have a book for that. I have a book for most things.

scenes.morningBook.lines.3.text.en: Each page is a craft Oakville forgot. This one’s Forestry — chapter one. My favourite!

scenes.morningBook.lines.4.text.en: Learning takes Knowledge — that’s my studying, bottled up. Pour it in…

scenes.morningBook.lines.5.text.en: …then a little Gold for proper axes, and the craft is ours again. Just like that!

scenes.morningBook.lines.6.text.en: Hear that? Axes in the woods! I study a point of Knowledge an hour, up to ten. Best spend it before then.

scenes.morningBook.lines.7.text.en: Let’s close the book and go and watch them work. I’ll — I’ll mark the page.

scenes.morningAxe.lines.0.text.en: Show ’em how it’s done, Majesty. Tap a tree. Every swing asks the land’s leave — a drop from that blue well.

scenes.morningAxe.lines.1.text.en: Hold it down and the axe keeps going. When a stand’s bare, move on — it grows back. Trees don’t sulk.

scenes.morningAxe.lines.2.text.en: Oh — the well is lower! Every swing drew a drop. Don’t fret: it fills again by itself. I checked twice.

scenes.morningRoof.lines.0.text.en: Wood at last — and nowhere to sleep. But that shape past the trees… the Millers’ house! Clear the fog, Your Majesty!

scenes.morningRoof.lines.1.text.en: There it is! The roof’s fallen in, but the walls are sound. Open it.

scenes.morningRoof.lines.2.text.en: Builders want their wood up front — it says so in the guild charter. Repair it!

scenes.morningRoof.lines.3.text.en: Hear that? Hammers! And builders keep at it while you’re away — they don’t need watching. Unlike me.

scenes.morningRoof.lines.4.text.en: Young Tom Miller’s camped on the south road. Been waiting a year for a roof to come home to.

scenes.morningFood.lines.0.text.en: A roof won’t feed Tom, and our pantry is… a shelf. Berry bushes would do. Clear the fog off one, then pick it.

scenes.morningVillager.lines.0.text.en: The House is still going up. Nobody moves in under scaffolding — I asked.

scenes.morningVillager.lines.1.text.en: A roof, a pantry… now Tom! The Townhall bell carries to the roads. Open it, Your Majesty.

scenes.morningVillager.lines.2.text.en: Ring for him! He’ll need that roof — and a little Food for the walk home.

scenes.morningVillager.lines.3.text.en: He’s coming! We can wait for him — or a few Gems would hurry him along. Whichever you think best!

scenes.morningVillager.lines.4.text.en: Is that… our roof? Your Majesty! Tom Miller, home at last. I’ll pay my rent on time, I swear it.

scenes.morningVillager.lines.5.text.en: Welcome home, Tom! You see, Your Majesty? Mend what the fog broke, and the people come back.

scenes.morningVillager.lines.6.text.en: Let’s close the Townhall — Tom’s settling in.

scenes.morningRent.lines.0.text.en: Tom pays his rent into the House. When the purse shows, gather it — it’s his to give, and it costs you nothing.

scenes.morningRent.lines.1.text.en: That’s how a kingdom is kept, I think: clear the fog, gather, build — and they come home, one by one.

scenes.morningRent.lines.2.text.en: Lost? Look at their request and I’ll point the way. Come back tomorrow — the barns and the purse fill up overnight.

scenes.plots.lines.0.text.en: Your Majesty! Before the fog, Dad kept two crop plots just past the Townhall. Best turnips in Oakville, he swore.

scenes.plots.lines.1.text.en: Turnips. Hmph. Fog’s had them a year. Nothing left in there but weeds and a scarecrow.

scenes.plots.lines.2.text.en: Weeds we can pull! First we buy the ground back from the fog — follow my finger, Your Majesty.

scenes.plots.lines.3.text.en: There it is! The fence is down, but the soil’s still good. Open it, Your Majesty.

scenes.plots.lines.4.text.en: A fence wants wood. Here — off my pile. Don’t make a fuss.

scenes.plots.lines.5.text.en: Fresh seed, a new fence, and no builders needed — a field mends itself once it’s sown. Repair it!

scenes.plots.lines.6.text.en: Sprouting already. Soil’s been waiting for somebody, that’s all.

scenes.plots.lines.7.text.en: And the other one, right beside it! Dad always planted them in pairs.

scenes.plots.lines.9.text.en: More wood? …Fine. Last of the pile. Again.

scenes.plots.lines.11.text.en: Two plots, just like Dad’s! When they’ve grown, tap them and bring the harvest in.

scenes.plots.lines.12.text.en: Every sickle swing asks the well, same as an axe. Mind the blue.

scenes.farm.lines.0.text.en: Reaping every plot by hand will wear us out — and drain the well. A Farm sends villagers to do it, day and night.

scenes.farm.lines.1.text.en: Dad’s old farm is still out there, past the berry bushes. Clear the way, Your Majesty — I’ll know it when I see it.

scenes.farm.lines.2.text.en: That’s her! Roof’s sagging, but she’s sound. Open it!

scenes.farm.lines.3.text.en: Farm wants wood too, does it. …Take it. I’ll chop more.

scenes.farm.lines.4.text.en: Hammers, sawdust and one cheerful racket — repair it!

scenes.farmMove.lines.0.text.en: Nearly done — listen to those hammers!

scenes.farmMove.lines.1.text.en: Oh. Oh no. A Farm works the plots one step around it, corners too — and ours are two steps away. I measured. Twice.

scenes.farmMove.lines.2.text.en: So pick it up and carry it. Did it with Widow Pell’s henhouse once. Hens weren’t pleased.

scenes.farmMove.lines.3.text.en: Can we? …We can! The guild charter says a building may be moved for free, as often as you like. Page forty!

scenes.farmMove.lines.4.text.en: It wants to stand right between the two plots. Clear the fog there first, Your Majesty.

scenes.farmMove.lines.6.text.en: That’s its Move knob. Tap it, and the whole Farm lifts right off the ground!

scenes.farmMove.lines.7.text.en: There — between Dad’s plots! Tap the spot.

scenes.farmMove.lines.8.text.en: Both plots in reach! Move it.

scenes.farmMove.lines.9.text.en: Didn’t drop a single plank. Better than the henhouse.

scenes.workers.lines.0.text.en: The Farm is still going up. When it stands, it’ll need hands.

scenes.workers.lines.1.text.en: The Farm stands — and nobody’s working it. Open it, Your Majesty!

scenes.workers.lines.2.text.en: Send me! I know every furrow. Each pair of hands walks to a plot, reaps it and carries the crop home.

scenes.workers.lines.3.text.en: Look at them go! The harvest piles up in the Farm’s barn — gather it when it’s ready. A full barn stops the work.

scenes.chest.lines.0.text.en: I nearly forgot, Your Majesty! I brought something home from the road — a whole chest of good timber.

scenes.chest.lines.1.text.en: Oh — let’s set this aside first, and step back out to the kingdom.

scenes.chest.lines.2.text.en: Into the Bag with it — that’s where I keep what the townsfolk give us. Open it, Your Majesty.

scenes.chest.lines.3.text.en: A chest holds hours of the town’s work, packed for later. Tap it.

scenes.chest.lines.4.text.en: Use it, and the wood is ours — just when we need it most.

scenes.chest.lines.5.text.en: Good timber, that. Keep the next ones for when you’re short — chests don’t rot.

scenes.chest.lines.6.text.en: Let’s close the Bag and put that wood to work.

scenes.secondHouse.lines.0.text.en: Oh — let’s set this aside first, and step back out to the kingdom.

scenes.secondHouse.lines.1.text.en: Word’s spreading on the roads, and Tom’s house is full. The fog kept no other… so we’ll raise one of our own!

scenes.secondHouse.lines.2.text.en: New house wants more wood than you’ve got. Here — been stacking it all winter. Don’t make a fuss.

scenes.secondHouse.lines.3.text.en: Builders want their wood up front — it says so in the guild charter. Choose the House.

scenes.secondHouse.lines.4.text.en: Anywhere on the cleared ground. Drag it wherever feels right, then confirm. I’d pick somewhere sunny.

scenes.sawmill.lines.0.text.en: Farm reaps by itself, and an old man’s still swinging an axe? There was a sawmill in the trees. Find it. Open it.

scenes.sawmill.lines.1.text.en: Mending it wants more wood than you’ve got. That’s the last of my pile, mind.

scenes.sawmill.lines.2.text.en: A Sawmill sends woodcutters into the trees around it — Wood without a single swing from you. Repair it!

scenes.sawmillCrew.lines.0.text.en: The Sawmill is still going up. When it stands, it’ll need hands.

scenes.sawmillCrew.lines.1.text.en: Sawmill’s up and nobody on the saws. Open it.

scenes.sawmillCrew.lines.2.text.en: Send it woodcutters. Young ones. The townsfolk want three at work — the Farm’s count too.

scenes.sawmillCrew.lines.3.text.en: Food and Wood come in by themselves now, even while you’re away. A real town, Your Majesty! I— I’m a little proud.

scenes.picks.lines.0.text.en: Oh — let’s set this aside first, and step back out to the kingdom.

scenes.picks.lines.1.text.en: Tom wants a second floor, and that wants stone. Nobody here can cut it — but I know a chapter that can!

scenes.picks.lines.2.text.en: Pickaxes. It opens the mountains to us.

scenes.picks.lines.4.text.en: …and a little Gold for the iron. Done!

scenes.picks.lines.5.text.en: Let’s close the book and go and find some rock.

scenes.rubble.lines.0.text.en: Tap a mountain — clear its fog first, if need be. Every swing brings home Stone. My back’s writing to complain.

scenes.capital.lines.0.text.en: Master Kofi, Builders’ Guild — Oakville chapter. Which is me. Three families under roofs? This town has earned a proper hall!

scenes.capital.lines.1.text.en: Master Kofi built half of old Oakville. The other half, he says, was built wrong.

scenes.capital.lines.2.text.en: Built by my cousin. Open the Townhall, Your Majesty — let’s see what she can become.

scenes.capital.lines.3.text.en: Upgrade! Every level asks for more than the last, and gives back more: more rent, more ground, more of everything.

scenes.capital.lines.4.text.en: The sheet says what she needs. Measure twice, pay once — then upgrade!

scenes.capital.lines.5.text.en: Hammers up! A bigger job takes longer. That’s not slowness, that’s craftsmanship — and builders keep at it while you’re away.

scenes.moreRoofs.lines.0.text.en: Your Majesty! My cousins are on the south road — three of them, and a goat. Could we raise them a roof?

scenes.moreRoofs.lines.1.text.en: Oh — let’s set this aside first, and step back out to the kingdom.

scenes.moreRoofs.lines.2.text.en: Guild charter, article twelve: a bigger hall, a bigger town. Four houses she allows now. To the Build menu!

scenes.moreRoofs.lines.3.text.en: Short on timber? The guild lends to a good cause. Just this once — don’t tell my cousin.

scenes.moreRoofs.lines.4.text.en: The House. Near the others — but not jammed against them.

scenes.moreRoofs.lines.5.text.en: Drag it where you like, then confirm. A house right against a house earns a little less — neighbours squabble over the fence.

scenes.furrows.lines.0.text.en: Two plots won’t feed a town. Dad always said: when the barn looks thin, sow.

scenes.furrows.lines.1.text.en: Oh — let’s set this aside first, and step back out to the kingdom.

scenes.furrows.lines.2.text.en: Agriculture says we may sow new plots on any cleared ground. Page seven!

scenes.furrows.lines.3.text.en: A crop plot. Put it by the Farm — its hands reach one step around, corners too.

scenes.furrows.lines.5.text.en: Oh — let’s set this aside first, and step back out to the kingdom.

scenes.furrows.lines.6.text.en: One more and we’ve four. Same again, Your Majesty!

scenes.faces.lines.0.text.en: Three roofs, room for six — and the roads are full of folk who’d come home, Your Majesty.

scenes.faces.lines.1.text.en: Then ring the bell again! Open the Townhall.

scenes.faces.lines.2.text.en: Ring for each of them — they wait their turn at the door, and each wants a little Food for the walk home.

scenes.faces.lines.4.text.en: That’s my cousins — and the goat. Welcome home, all of you!

scenes.barn.lines.0.text.en: The Farm’s barn fills before I can carry it home — and when it’s full, the work stops dead.

scenes.barn.lines.1.text.en: Then build it bigger. Every building climbs, a level at a time. Open the Farm.

scenes.barn.lines.2.text.en: Upgrade: a bigger barn, quicker hands. The Townhall says how high anything in town may climb.

scenes.twoSaws.lines.0.text.en: One sawmill. One old man’s worth of wood. Build another — in the thick of the trees, mind.

scenes.twoSaws.lines.1.text.en: Oh — let’s set this aside first, and step back out to the kingdom.

scenes.twoSaws.lines.3.text.en: Short again? The guild covers it. We’ll call it an investment in Oakville.

scenes.twoSaws.lines.5.text.en: It starts where the trees are thickest. Leave it there. Confirm.

scenes.hands.lines.0.text.en: New saws, and nobody on them. Open the new one.

scenes.hands.lines.1.text.en: Two hands. Each walks to a tree in reach, cuts, and carries it home.

scenes.hands.lines.2.text.en: Mind, Your Majesty: more hands than trees in reach, and the extra ones just stand about. Count before you send them.

scenes.pride.lines.0.text.en: Excuse me! Your Majesty? I’m Priya. I’m nine and three quarters, and this town is UGLY.

scenes.pride.lines.1.text.en: Priya! …She’s not wrong. The fog took every flower in Oakville.

scenes.pride.lines.2.text.en: Oh — let’s set this aside first, and step back out to the kingdom.

scenes.pride.lines.3.text.en: Isolde has a book with flower beds in it. I’ve seen it! Read it!

scenes.pride.lines.4.text.en: Village Pride. Benches, lanterns, flower beds — Isolde’s second favourite chapter.

scenes.pride.lines.6.text.en: …and a little Gold. Done! Done done done!

scenes.pride.lines.7.text.en: Close the book, quick — I want to build!

scenes.corner.lines.0.text.en: Now the fun part: something pretty, anywhere you like! But beside a house is best.

scenes.corner.lines.1.text.en: It’s true — a house beside a decoration collects a little more Gold. Folk pay for a nice view. I checked twice.

scenes.corner.lines.2.text.en: Oh — let’s set this aside first, and step back out to the kingdom.

scenes.corner.lines.6.text.en: Next to a house. Then confirm!

scenes.corner.lines.7.text.en: Oh — let’s set this aside first, and step back out to the kingdom.

scenes.corner.lines.8.text.en: Lovely! Now one more — back to the Build menu.

scenes.corner.lines.10.text.en: …and this one’s yours to choose. Then put it somewhere lovely.

scenes.corner.lines.11.text.en: Psst — anything you build can be moved, any time, for free. Hold it and drag. Make the town yours!

scenes.upperFloors.lines.0.text.en: One house with an upper floor and the rest still cottages? Article thirty: a street climbs together.

scenes.upperFloors.lines.1.text.en: Each House to level two — open them one by one and upgrade. Stone for the floors, Gold for the joiners.

scenes.barracks.lines.0.text.en: The Warrior’s drill is written down. Now I need a yard to drill in, Your Majesty — a Barracks.

scenes.barracks.lines.1.text.en: Oh — let’s set this aside first, and step back out to the kingdom.

scenes.barracks.lines.5.text.en: Somewhere with room to march. Confirm.

scenes.recruits.lines.0.text.en: The Barracks stands. Open it, Your Majesty.

scenes.recruits.lines.1.text.en: Recruit! A soldier wants Food, Gold and a little time — and the yard trains while you sleep.

scenes.recruits.lines.2.text.en: One. Orcs come in dozens. Thirty make a company — keep the yard busy.

scenes.assault.lines.0.text.en: Thirty strong. It’s time. Tap their camp, Your Majesty.

scenes.assault.lines.1.text.en: Attack — and we choose who goes.

scenes.assault.lines.2.text.en: Quick deploy sends the best we have. Or set each squad where you want it.

scenes.assault.lines.3.text.en: The numbers say how it goes before we march — and how many won’t come home. Ready? Attack!

scenes.summon.lines.0.text.en: Your first hero’s on the house, love! Open the Tavern.

scenes.summon.lines.1.text.en: Call! The banner’s in the store.

scenes.summon.lines.2.text.en: Free, this once. Whoever answers is yours for good.

scenes.summon.lines.3.text.en: A hero! They lead your soldiers into a fight, and grow with every one. The Heroes tab keeps them all.

scenes.secondFarm.lines.0.text.en: Two plots to a farm was Dad’s way. Two farms is mine! Build it among new plots.

scenes.secondFarm.lines.1.text.en: Oh — let’s set this aside first, and step back out to the kingdom.

scenes.secondFarm.lines.4.text.en: Where it reaches plots of its own. Confirm!

scenes.civic.lines.0.text.en: Isolde found ANOTHER chapter. Topiary! I’m going to need very small shears.

scenes.civic.lines.1.text.en: Oh — let’s set this aside first, and step back out to the kingdom.

scenes.civic.lines.3.text.en: Civic Pride: clipped bushes, banners and a birdbath. For the birds. Obviously.

scenes.civic.lines.6.text.en: Close the book! The birds are waiting.

scenes.townhall2.lines.0.text.en: A grander Townhall! Its bell carries further now — the dotted line marks how far we can push the fog.

scenes.survey.lines.0.text.en: And the Royal Survey! The crown pays for every page we win back. Well — you’re the crown. But it’s tradition!

scenes.builders.lines.0.text.en: Every builder is busy — I counted. Wait for one to finish, or hire another pair of hands, and two things rise at once.

scenes.manaEmpty.lines.0.text.en: The well has run dry, Your Majesty. It fills again by itself, about a pool a night — or our patrons could refill it now.

scenes.eras.lines.0.text.en: Oh — let’s set this aside first, and step back out to the kingdom.

scenes.eras.lines.1.text.en: You’ve seen more of the land than any monarch in years — and look, the tree has noticed! A new chapter can open.

scenes.firstLair.lines.0.text.en: Your Majesty — a camp, past the fog! They’ve smelled our smoke. A town coming back to life draws company. Tap it… carefully.

scenes.firstLair.lines.1.text.en: Raiders! See that clock? When it runs out, they rob our stores — and nothing near their camp can be worked while it stands.

scenes.firstLair.lines.2.text.en: Axes won’t do, not against that lot. You want soldiers — and the book knows how. Look for the Warrior.

scenes.orcs.lines.0.text.en: Grrr. Your town smells of bread and gold. We come for both.

scenes.orcs.lines.1.text.en: Warden of the Guard, Your Majesty — what’s left of it. We followed your smoke home. Give me soldiers.

scenes.orcs.lines.2.text.en: Soldiers… there’s a chapter on Barracks, I’m sure of it. Let me read up on it first—

scenes.orcs.lines.3.text.en: Read. With respect, Your Majesty — orcs don’t wait for chapter two.

scenes.orcs.lines.4.text.en: Oh — let’s set this aside first, and step back out to the kingdom.

scenes.orcs.lines.5.text.en: Then I’ll read very quickly! The Barracks is in the research tree — let’s open it together.

scenes.raid.lines.0.text.en: They’ve had my woodpile. MY woodpile.

scenes.raid.lines.1.text.en: Never the treasury, at least. Gather often and they find less — clear the camp to win it all back.

scenes.battle.lines.0.text.en: Pick who goes in: as many soldiers as you can spare. The numbers tell you how it’ll go before we march.

scenes.victory.lines.0.text.en: They’re scattered! And look what they left behind.

scenes.victory.lines.1.text.en: Oakville is safe! Take the camp — whatever they stole comes home, and the ground is ours again.

scenes.relics.lines.0.text.en: Oh — let’s set this aside first, and step back out to the kingdom.

scenes.relics.lines.1.text.en: A piece of an old relic! Find all six and it can be restored — the rest are out in the lairs and the fog. I keep the pieces in the Bag.

scenes.magic.lines.0.text.en: Oh — let’s set this aside first, and step back out to the kingdom.

scenes.magic.lines.1.text.en: Do you feel that? The old stones hum — the well runs deeper already. I’ve waited years for this.

scenes.tavern.lines.0.text.en: Doors open, fire lit, soup on! Heroes will come from every road for a bowl of this.

scenes.tavern.lines.1.text.en: Oh — let’s set this aside first, and step back out to the kingdom.

scenes.tavern.lines.2.text.en: The Tavern flies the banner — your first hero is on the house! And a new book, the Sagas! Heroes, legends… my favourite shelf.

scenes.towerSighted.lines.0.text.en: Do you see that shape on the northern hills? Something tall, past the fog. Clear the way towards it and we’ll know. I hope it’s friendly.

scenes.watchtowerSeen.lines.0.text.en: An old watchtower! Its great lens is gone — torn out. From its top you could see past the mountains. Oh, I’d love to sketch it.

scenes.watchtowerRepair.lines.0.text.en: The lens the Orcs carried off — it belongs to the old watchtower! Let’s put it back. Tap the tower.

scenes.watchtowerRepair.lines.1.text.en: Set the lens and mend the stair. One minute, and we’ll see past the mountains. Repair it!

scenes.world.lines.0.text.en: The tower stands, and the lens is clear! Look, Your Majesty — come and see what lies past the hills.

scenes.world.lines.1.text.en: Other kingdoms. Other banners! And all that mist between us… we’ll need someone with good boots.

scenes.explorer.lines.0.text.en: Wren, Royal Scout, at your service! Boots laced, compass oiled — I’m ready the moment you send me.

scenes.explorer.lines.1.text.en: Sending a scout costs Gold, as a rule… but this first trip is on the crown. I’ve already signed the chit!

scenes.explorer.lines.2.text.en: See the mist next door? Something’s waiting under it. Tap that hex, Your Majesty.

scenes.explorer.lines.4.text.en: I’m off! I’ll walk there, have a good look round, and send word when I’m done. Then come and see what I found.

scenes.explorer.lines.5.text.en: She always sends word. Usually by shouting it across the valley.

scenes.explorerReady.lines.0.text.en: Your Majesty! I’m done at the hex — you’ll want to see this. Tap my message and I’ll take you there.

scenes.explorerReady.lines.1.text.en: Here I am! Tap the hex, and I’ll show you everything I found.

scenes.explorerReady.lines.2.text.en: Look at all that land — and what I dug up is already in your purse. I’ll head home now; send me out again once I’m back.

scenes.explorerReady.lines.3.text.en: Every trip pushes the mist back a little further. I’ll keep the map — and the ledger!

scenes.claim.lines.0.text.en: Look at all that ground — and nobody’s! Build on a hex beside the city, and it’s ours.

scenes.claim.lines.1.text.en: Its feature says what we’ll build: woods make a logging camp, a field a farm. Build!

scenes.claim.lines.2.text.en: Each hex fills its own store — tap it to send it home. And each one we hold costs a little more than the last.

scenes.camps.lines.0.text.en: Tents on that hex — a monster camp. It guards its ground: nobody claims it till it’s beaten.

scenes.camps.lines.1.text.en: Beat it with an army and the hex is ours to take. Leave it, and it’s back in half a day.

scenes.dungeon.lines.0.text.en: A dungeon! Three depths, eight rooms each, and treasure all the way down.

scenes.dungeon.lines.1.text.en: Camp an army at its door and delve, room by room. Nobody can hold a dungeon — only empty it.

scenes.portal.lines.0.text.en: The Dark Portal is open! Once a week it opens, and every kingdom races down it.

scenes.portal.lines.1.text.en: Each floor down pays more than the last. Send your strongest — and see who goes deepest.

scenes.shrineSeen.lines.0.text.en: A shrine in ruins! Repaired, it can hold a relic and lend us its power. Though not while the Orcs squat beside it.

scenes.shrineRelic.lines.0.text.en: The shrine stands again! And look what the Orcs left behind — the Staff of Renewal, whole. It wants an altar. Tap the shrine.

scenes.shrineRelic.lines.1.text.en: A relic set on this altar lends the kingdom its power. Tap the altar.

scenes.shrineRelic.lines.2.text.en: There's the Staff. It renews the land round the shrine: woods, fields and stone hold more and grow back faster. Choose it.

scenes.shrineRelic.lines.3.text.en: Now Select, and it takes its place.

scenes.shrineRelic.lines.4.text.en: It sleeps until we wake it with Mana. Activate it and its power fills the ground round the shrine. It grows longer, wider and stronger.

scenes.huntSeen.lines.0.text.en: Boar! Not had boar since the fog came. Mind — they bite back. Learn Hunting first.

scenes.ironSeen.lines.0.text.en: Iron in that rock! The Quarry can’t cut it until we learn Mining — and then it’s worth five bare peaks.

scenes.goldSeen.lines.0.text.en: Gold in the rock. That’s what the fog likes best — mind it doesn’t get ideas. Mining’ll get it out.

scenes.fishSeen.lines.0.text.en: Fish in the shallows! The Docks will net them, once we learn to build on the water. I can’t swim, so… boats.

scenes.harpies.lines.0.text.en: Harpies. Every shiny thing in the valley, gone by morning — the fog with feathers. And our stone with them.

scenes.wounded.lines.0.text.en: They came home hurt, not lost. The Infirmary patches them up for less than a new recruit.

scenes.workshops.lines.0.text.en: A workshop! Planks from Wood, cut stone from rock — and our grandest levels ask for them.

scenes.workshops.lines.1.text.en: Queue the work on its card. The crew keeps at it while you’re away, as far as its queue is long.

scenes.harmony.lines.0.text.en: The grand pieces — gardens, wells, statues! I may faint.

scenes.harmony.lines.1.text.en: Past level seven, the big buildings ask for Harmony, and only beauty pays it. Keep more than they ask and the purse fills faster too.

scenes.speedups.lines.0.text.en: A builder’s hourglass! The guild hands them out for good work.

scenes.speedups.lines.1.text.en: Anything that waits — a build, an upgrade, soldiers in the yard — shows Speed up on its card. Spend one there and the wait shrinks.

scenes.speedups.lines.2.text.en: Oh — let’s set this aside first, and step back out to the kingdom.

scenes.speedups.lines.3.text.en: They’re kept in the Bag, with everything else.

scenes.storeFull.lines.0.text.en: Your Majesty! A store’s full to the rafters — and a full store stops the work dead.

scenes.storeFull.lines.1.text.en: Tap it and bring it home. Gather often, and nothing stands idle.

scenes.idleCrew.lines.0.text.en: Some hands are standing about — there isn’t ground enough in reach for all of them.

scenes.idleCrew.lines.1.text.en: Move the building nearer the work, or send them elsewhere. A tap on its card, and the − takes them off.

scenes.knowledgeFull.lines.0.text.en: My head’s full! Ten points of Knowledge, and not one more will fit. I tried.

scenes.knowledgeFull.lines.1.text.en: Spend some in the book before more goes to waste. Anything that’s lit up, we can learn.

scenes.store.lines.0.text.en: Marisol Vega, merchant of everywhere! Gems, chests, a bargain or two. Royal prices — for royals.

scenes.store.lines.1.text.en: She once sold my aunt a bridge.

scenes.store.lines.2.text.en: A lovely bridge! Over a lovely river. Come and browse, Your Majesty — the stall opens now and then with something special.

scenes.store.lines.3.text.en: Oh — let’s set this aside first, and step back out to the kingdom.

scenes.friends.lines.0.text.en: Idris, royal courier! Letters, Your Majesty — from other kingdoms. Friends!

scenes.friends.lines.1.text.en: Write back, and they’ll lend a hand each day. Pin a wish on the board, and a friend can fill it.

scenes.friends.lines.2.text.en: And we can fill theirs. That’s what neighbours are for — the good ones, anyway.

scenes.friends.lines.3.text.en: The letters are here. I’ll keep them coming!

scenes.notices.lines.0.text.en: News, Your Majesty! When something happens while you’re busy, I pin a note here on the right.

scenes.notices.lines.1.text.en: Tap a note to read it — it takes you straight to what happened. Saves my legs.

scenes.transplant.lines.0.text.en: Transplanting! Hold a tree and it lifts right out of the ground.

scenes.transplant.lines.1.text.en: Put it wherever the town looks best. It sulks for a day while it settles — then it’s good as new.

scenes.landmarkSeen.lines.0.text.en: Standing stones! The old magic sleeps in them — I can feel it from here.

scenes.landmarkSeen.lines.1.text.en: Clear the fog around them and claim them. The well runs deeper for every one we wake.

scenes.atlas.lines.0.text.en: The Atlas! Maps of everything past the hills.

scenes.atlas.lines.1.text.en: None of its cards is needed, and they don’t come cheap — but every one makes the road easier. Pick the roads you’ll walk.

scenes.atlas.lines.2.text.en: Oh — let’s set this aside first, and step back out to the kingdom.

scenes.evolution.lines.0.text.en: Warriors, second rank! Better steel, harder drill.

scenes.evolution.lines.1.text.en: The Barracks trains them now — if its level is high enough. A rank II soldier is worth two raw ones.

scenes.warCamp.lines.0.text.en: A War Camp! From here our armies march out onto the world board.

scenes.warCamp.lines.1.text.en: To beat the camps, to take ground, to hold it. Every soldier out there is one away from home — send what you can spare.

scenes.warCamp.lines.2.text.en: Oh — let’s set this aside first, and step back out to the kingdom.
